title: Amsterdam to the Swiss Alps
name: Amsterdam to the Alps
stays: Amsterdam · Cologne · Frankfurt · Lucerne · Interlaken · Zurich
p1: Twelve days and eleven nights through the Netherlands, Germany and Switzerland. A sunset dinner cruise on Amsterdam’s canals, first-class trains along the Rhine, fondue in Lucerne, the First Flyer zipline above Grindelwald and a sunset cruise on Lake Thun.
p2: Eleven nights of hotels, group arrival and departure transfers, private coaches, first-class rail where listed and every included experience are arranged, with 11 breakfasts, a lunch and four dinners.
storyImg: The Chapel Bridge water tower in Lucerne
presImg: A Swiss lake reflecting the Alps
presText: Two nights in Lucerne and two in Interlaken bring the Alps close: a group dinner of fondue or raclette, a gondola to Grindelwald-First, and an evening sunset cruise on Lake Thun.
